title: When Private Information Settles the Bill: Money and Privacy in Google's Market for Smartphone Applications
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional and app-week panel regressions (reg/xtreg fe) of the paid/free choice, price and installations on continuous privacy-permission measures (num_perm_clean_pse, pg_sp_pse) with category, content and week dummies and app controls; matched app pairs and an Android-iOS comparison. Continuous regressors, no binary staggered treatment.
design_notes: Stata. Scraped Google Play data shipped (current_cross_section.dta, detailed_balanced_panel.dta, cross_section_pairs_*.dta, iOS_android_reg_data.dta).
data_files_note: readme_replication.txt: run kummer_schulte_main_results_replication.do on the shipped data.
screener_notes: Batch metadata had no title; title and authors taken from the readme and do-file (Kummer and Schulte). Not a DiD paper.
